definition: asking many people the same question
description: A sunny old-town square with stone buildings, iron balconies, café chairs and a stone fountain. Two tall clear tubes stand on the paving: one is filling with green tennis balls, the other with orange balls. A young woman in a blue denim jacket stands between them, and a young woman in a lilac top holds a green ball, bends down and drops it into the green tube. A young man with a skateboard stands nearby, a cyclist rides past behind, people watch and chat, and a pigeon flies up from the ground.

es.answer: Está pasando en bici junto a la fuente.
